text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock D and Stock E after gains, which felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each holding’s risk and role in my portfolio.","I tend to hold on rather than trade, especially when selling at a loss would feel painful. I should avoid letting my purchase price dictate decisions and reassess holdings objectively.","Recent price moves do not predict what comes next. I should make measured decisions based on risk, diversification, and long-term goals rather than short-term fluctuations."]}
